name: RMK (Russkaya Mednaya Kompaniya)
verdict: Private Russian copper producer owned by founder Igor Altushkin. Nothing found.
note: Club partner of HC Traktor (club site footer); RMK was reported as the club's title sponsor with 100m roubles a year when the deal began (1obl.ru and fedpress.ru, both unreachable from the research environment — see PR). On the 2026-27 home jersey the RMK mark sits on the shoulder yoke and on the helmet back (club match photos).
